message.content:
The bug is at line 8: when the address starts with "::", `--tp` decrements `tp` from `tmp` to `tmp[-1]`, an out-of-bounds pointer. Subsequent writes at lines 14–15 then write before the array (and `colonp` computations are off by one).

Answer: 8
